provider: Contabo GPU VPS (Contabo GmbH, Germany) - 1x dedicated NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96GB via PCI passthrough, 18 vCPU, 96GB RAM, 900GB NVMe; PLUS netcup vGPU root servers (netcup GmbH, Germany) - NVIDIA H200 vGPU slices (RS 2000 vGPU 7 / RS 4000 vGPU 14). VERDICT: the 'likely-dead' hypothesis is REFUTED for Contabo (GPU VPS launched ~Sept 2026, live), but the only Contabo SKU is a 96GB card far over-sized and over-priced for a 7B Q4 and over the EUR 150 cap; netcup vGPU exists but is SOLD OUT / 'currently not available'. Neither fits the budget.
region_dc: Contabo GPU VPS: 'Europe' and 'US Central' only at launch; exact EU city not stated on the product page [uncertain] (Contabo EU DCs are Germany-based, Nuremberg/Munich historically). Contabo also resells vshosting (Czech sister company) GPU cloud (L40S, RTX PRO 5000/6000, H200, B300) - separate quote-based product, EU DCs, no public prices [uncertain]. netcup vGPU: Nuremberg, Germany only.
sovereignty_class: Contabo: German HQ (Contabo GmbH, Munich) + EU DC option = EU HQ + EU DC; no US parent identified [uncertain: ownership/investor structure not verified]. Certifications: ISO 27001 claimed by Contabo historically [uncertain, not re-verified]; no BSI C5, SecNumCloud, HDS found. netcup: German HQ (Karlsruhe), data centre Nuremberg, 'ISO-certified' company per its own page, GDPR-compliant; BSI C5 not found [uncertain which ISO standards].
monthly_cost: Contabo GPU VPS: list USD 1,199/mo (Contabo blog Oct 2026, no setup fee). Page shows a promo effective rate of EUR 999.00/mo incl. VAT for a 24-month term (an excl.-VAT figure of ~799 is also shown [uncertain how to read it]). 24/7 = ~EUR 800-1,000+/mo, i.e. 5-7x the EUR 150 cap. No per-hour billing, so no POC-hours option (minimum 1 month prepaid ~ EUR 800-1,000). netcup RS 2000 vGPU 7 (7GB VRAM H200 slice, 8 vCore, 16GB RAM): EUR 121.77/mo incl. 19% VAT (~EUR 102 net), the only variant near budget, but sold out. RS 4000 vGPU 14: EUR 232.43/mo incl. VAT (over budget). Contabo CPU-only alternative (not GPU): e.g. Cloud VPS in the EUR 10-60 range, CPU llama.cpp only [uncertain, not priced here].
billing_granularity: Contabo GPU VPS: flat monthly (annual/24-month discounted rates), no per-hour or scale-to-zero; always-on. netcup vGPU: monthly with minimum 1-month term; netcup standard vServers are hourly-billable but vGPU hourly billing not confirmed [uncertain]. Neither scales to zero.
setup_fee_and_lockin: Contabo GPU VPS: no setup fee; minimum initial contract 1 month; renewals equal to initial term; cancellation: none if pre-paid, 4 weeks if post-paid. The EUR 999 promo price requires a 24-month commitment (lock-in of ~EUR 24k) - avoid. netcup vGPU: no setup fee found [uncertain]; minimum 1-month term advertised. Exit cost low for both (unmanaged Linux, standard Docker/llama.cpp).
gen_tps_7b_q4: [uncertain] Bandwidth-derived, NOT measured. Contabo RTX PRO 6000: 1,597 GB/s / ~4.4GB Q4_K_M = ~360 t/s theoretical ceiling; realistic llama.cpp CUDA ~150-220 t/s single stream (llama.cpp typically hits 45-60% of bandwidth ceiling on small models). Roughly 6-9x the M4 mini reference (TG=24 t/s). netcup H200 7GB vGPU slice: bandwidth share per slice not published [uncertain]; full H200 is ~4.8 TB/s, a 7/141 slice likely does not get proportional bandwidth, expect well below RTX PRO 6000.
prefill_tps: [uncertain] Compute-derived estimate, NOT measured: RTX PRO 6000 (120 FP32 TFLOPS, 5th-gen tensor cores) ~8,000-15,000 t/s PP for 7B Q4_K_M in llama.cpp (vs M4 mini PP512=221 t/s = ~40-70x faster). netcup vGPU slice: unknown [uncertain].
ttft_at_4k: [uncertain] Derived: ~0.3-0.6 s at 4k prompt tokens on Contabo RTX PRO 6000 (4k / ~10k t/s + overhead); for 8k tool-schema prompts ~0.6-1.0 s. Not measured. M4 mini reference would be ~18 s at 4k.
concurrency_slots: [uncertain] Contabo 96GB VRAM minus 4.5GB weights leaves ~90GB for KV: for a Mistral-7B-class GQA arch (8 KV heads) ~0.125 GB per 1k tokens f16, so 16+ slots at 32k ctx is VRAM-feasible; throughput (not memory) bounds concurrency, practically -np 8-16. netcup 7GB slice: ~2.5GB free for KV after weights = roughly 16-20k total tokens, i.e. 1-2 slots at 8k ctx; not suitable for agentic multi-slot.
ctx_ram_headroom: Contabo: 96GB VRAM + 96GB system RAM, so full native context of any Bielik 7B variant (8-32k) fits with many slots, even much larger models (Contabo FAQ: 70B at FP8, Devstral-2-123B, Nemotron-Nano-30B confirmed to run). netcup RS 2000 vGPU 7: only 7GB VRAM dedicated, 16GB RAM; model 4.5GB + ~2.5GB leaves roughly 16-20k tokens KV total (or quantised KV for more) and no room for a DFlash draft model of any size; very tight. RS 4000 vGPU 14 (14GB VRAM) comfortable.
availability_status: Contabo GPU VPS: orderable now (configurator live, Ubuntu 24.04 + CUDA image, launched ~Sept 2026; 'no long provisioning queue' claimed; EU and US Central regions) [uncertain: real stock not tested; Contabo notes GPU capacity is hard to plan]. netcup vGPU: both RS 2000 vGPU 7 and RS 4000 vGPU 14 show SOLD OUT and banner 'This product is currently not available' as of the 2026-10-21 page fetch (waitlist not mentioned). netcup site also carried a banner: services temporarily shut down due to a critical PHP vulnerability (see netcup-status.de), unclear scope [uncertain]. No Contabo/netcup A10, L4, RTX 4000/4090-class small GPU in their own catalogs; vshosting offers L40S / RTX PRO 5000 on quote [uncertain].
egress_traffic: Contabo GPU VPS: incoming unlimited; outgoing 'unlimited' subject to fair-usage policy with throttle right for exceptional usage; no overage fees. Agentic LLM traffic is tiny, non-issue. netcup vGPU: traffic terms not confirmed from the fetched page [uncertain]; netcup VPS/root servers typically include generous unmetered traffic.
electricity_metering: Not applicable: VPS / vGPU, power bundled in monthly price. For reference RTX PRO 6000 Server Edition TDP is ~600W (card is oversized for 7B); H200 ~700W shared among slices.
hosting_model: Self-host on unmanaged VPS: root access, Ubuntu 24.04 with NVIDIA driver, CUDA toolkit and nvidia-container-toolkit preinstalled; Contabo 1-click apps include Ollama, Docker, Coolify, OpenClaw, n8n; custom .iso/.qcow2 images supported. You run llama.cpp yourself, with full control of chat template and tool-call parser (--jinja). No managed model API; patching/backups are the customer's job. netcup vGPU: also unmanaged root server, images list not confirmed [uncertain]; CUDA support asked in FAQ but answers not retrievable [uncertain].
tool_calling_support: Depends entirely on own llama.cpp build: llama-server --jinja exposes OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with server-side tool-call parsing for supported templates. Not provider-specific; Bielik template/parser compatibility must be validated by us [uncertain].
spec_decode_support: Contabo: yes in principle, llama.cpp -md draft model fits trivially in 96GB VRAM; DFlash-specific compatibility with llama.cpp not verified here [uncertain]. netcup 7GB slice: effectively no headroom for a draft model; 14GB slice possible.
sla_uptime: Contabo: marketing states SLA-backed reliability across locations but no GPU-VPS-specific uptime percentage found [uncertain]; historically Contabo VPS SLA is a 99.9% network uptime claim [uncertain, not re-verified for GPU VPS]. netcup: SLA figure for vGPU not retrieved [uncertain]. Neither is GPU-grade managed SLA.
llm_inference_tos: Contabo: LLM inference is an explicitly advertised use case (self-host LLM, Ollama 1-click app, confirmed models list); no restriction found. Fair-usage throttling clause on outbound traffic applies. netcup: 'AI inferencing' explicitly listed as target scenario for vGPU; no restriction found.
price_stability: Contabo: GPU VPS launched ~Sept 2026, so no price history; blog dated Oct 2026 quotes USD 1,199 and page shows a promo effective rate for a 24-month term, so list vs promo gap is large and promo may end [uncertain]. Contabo has a history of list price changes on VPS tiers [uncertain]. USD-based comparison table vs EUR page prices means FX float. netcup vGPU: new product, sold out, no history; netcup generally keeps stable but adjusts prices by generation [uncertain].
model_lock_in: None: bring-your-own GGUF container on a plain VPS, so Bielik cannot be removed from a catalog. Contabo ships no managed model catalog. Main risk is stock/availability of the GPU SKU, not model lock-in.
